plates.side_label: 16 JAN 1902 BAYLISS & STARLING 4-STEP PROOF: (1) INTACT + ACID → FLOW, (2) NERVES CUT + ACID → FLOW, (3) ACID IN VEIN → 0, (4) MUCOSA EXTRACT (SECRETIN) IN VEIN → MASSIVE FLOW
plates.quality_reason: Flow-first: a teach diagram, chart, counter or timeline is a £0 code graphic. No Flow mint.
plates.reference: Own code graphic: on period paper, an inked Bayliss & Starling (1902, Proc. R. Soc. Lond. 69: 352–353 & J. Physiol. 28: 325–353) four-step experimental proof chart compares (1) acid in intact duodenum -> secretion, (2) acid in completely denervated jejunum loop -> full secretion after ~2 min, (3) acid injected directly into blood vein -> 0 secretion, and (4) acid-ground jejunal mucosa extract (secretin) injected into vein -> massive pancreatic secretion.
